title: Certify store identities over numeral expressions of one value
summary: The Lean reconstructor now matches array store identities whose indices or values are numeral expressions of equal value, such as (* 1 2) and (- 3 1), by first rewriting each expression to its value with a grind-proved fact. Rewrite steps that Z3's rewriter folded by value now check in Lean, with no new trusted steps.
